sql.workQueueType.getTypesForCompany: select wqt.id, wqt.company_id, wqt.work_queue_type, wqt.archived, wqt.work_queue_category_id, wqc.work_queue_category, wqt.display_order, wqc.display_order as work_queue_category_display_order from flow.work_queue_type wqt inner join flow.work_queue_category wqc on wqc.id = wqt.work_queue_category_id where wqt.company_id = :companyId and wqt.archived is not true
sql.workQueueType.getType: select wqt.id, wqt.company_id, wqt.work_queue_type, wqt.archived, wqt.work_queue_category_id, wqc.work_queue_category, wqt.display_order, s.id as smartlist_id, wqc.color as work_queue_category_color, wqc.display_order as work_queue_category_display_order from flow.work_queue_type wqt inner join flow.work_queue_category wqc on wqc.id = wqt.work_queue_category_id inner join flow.smartlist s on s.work_queue_type_id = wqt.id where wqt.id = :id
sql.workQueueType.addSmartlist: insert into flow.smartlist (name, company_object_type_id, shared, owner_id, created_by_id, view_object_type_id, main_process_steps, project_details, work_queue_type_id) values (:workQueueType, (select id from flow.company_object_type cot where cot.company_id = :companyId and cot.object_type_id = 4), true, 99999999, :createdById, 1, true, false, :workQueueTypeId)
sql.workQueueType.deleteType: update flow.work_queue_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.updateType: update flow.work_queue_type set work_queue_type = :workQueueType, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), work_queue_category_id = :workQueueCategoryId, display_order = :displayOrder where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.insertType: insert into flow.work_queue_type(company_id, work_queue_type, created_by_id, work_queue_category_id, display_order) values (:companyId, :workQueueType, :createdById, :workQueueCategoryId, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.work_queue_type where work_queue_category_id = :workQueueCategoryId and archived is not true))
sql.workQueueType.getAvailableWorkQueueTypes: select wqt.*, wqc.work_queue_category from flow.work_queue_type wqt inner join flow.work_queue_category wqc on wqc.id = wqt.work_queue_category_id where wqt.archived is not true and wqt.company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt where pswqt.work_queue_type_id = wqt.id and pswqt.process_step_id = :id and archived is not true ) order by wqt.work_queue_type
sql.workQueueType.getProcessStepWorkQueueTyp: SELECT pswqt.id, pswqt.work_queue_type_id, pswqt.created_by_id, pswqt.process_step_id, pswqt.modified_by_id, wqt.work_queue_type, wqc.work_queue_category, pswqt.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(projectStatuses))) FROM ( SELECT pswqtpst.id, pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id as "processStepWorkQueueTypeId", coalesce(cpst.project_status_type, pst.project_status_type) as "projectStatusType", pswqtpst.company_project_status_type_id as "companyProjectStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.project_status_type_id as "projectStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.archived FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type_project_status_type pswqtpst left join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on pswqtpst.company_project_status_type_id = cpst.id left join flow.project_status_type pst on pswqtpst.project_status_type_id = pst.id WHERE pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id = pswqt.id AND pswqtpst.archived is not true order by pst.project_status_type, cpst.project_status_type ) projectStatuses), '[]') AS "projectStatuses", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(processStepStatuses))) FROM ( SELECT pswqtpsst.id, pswqtpsst.process_step_work_queue_type_id as "processStepWorkQueueTypeId", pswqtpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", pswqtpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", pswqtpsst.archived, coalesce(cpsst.process_step_status_type, psst.process_step_status_type) as "processStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type pswqtpsst left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pswqtpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id left join flow.process_step_status_type psst on pswqtpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pswqtpsst.process_step_work_queue_type_id = pswqt.id AND pswqtpsst.archived is not true order by psst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type ) processStepStatuses), '[]') AS "processStepStatuses" FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt inner join flow.work_queue_type wqt on wqt.id = pswqt.work_queue_type_id inner join flow.work_queue_category wqc on wqc.id = wqt.work_queue_category_id where pswqt.id = :id
sql.workQueueType.insertProcessStepWorkQueue: insert into flow.process_step_work_queue_type (process_step_id, work_queue_type_id, created_by_id) values (:processStepId, :workQueueTypeId, :createdById)
sql.workQueueType.deleteProcessStepWorkQueue: update flow.process_step_work_queue_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.insertProjectStatusType: insert into flow.process_step_work_queue_type_project_status_type(company_project_status_type_id, project_status_type_id, process_step_work_queue_type_id, created_by_id) values (:companyProjectStatusTypeId, :projectStatusTypeId, :processStepWorkQueueTypeId, :userId)
sql.workQueueType.updateProjectStatusType: update flow.process_step_work_queue_type_project_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.getProjectStatusesForWorkQ: SELECT pswqtpst.id, pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id as "processStepWorkQueueTypeId", pswqtpst.company_project_status_type_id as "companyProjectStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.project_status_type_id as "projectStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.archived, coalesce(cpst.project_status_type, pst.project_status_type) as "projectStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type_project_status_type pswqtpst left join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on pswqtpst.company_project_status_type_id = cpst.id left join flow.project_status_type pst on pswqtpst.project_status_type_id = pst.id WHERE pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id = :processStepWorkQueueTypeId AND pswqtpst.archived is not true order by pst.project_status_type, cpst.project_status_type
sql.workQueueType.insertProcessStepStatusTyp: insert into flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type(company_process_step_status_type_id, process_step_status_type_id, process_step_work_queue_type_id, created_by_id) values (:companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, :processStepStatusTypeId, :processStepWorkQueueTypeId, :userId)
sql.workQueueType.updateProcessStepStatusTyp: update flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.workQueueType.getProcessStepStatusesForW: SELECT pswqtpst.id, pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id as "processStepWorkQueueTypeId", pswqtpst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", pswqtpst.archived, coalesce(cpst.process_step_status_type, pst.process_step_status_type) as "processStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type pswqtpst left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpst on pswqtpst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpst.id left join flow.process_step_status_type pst on pswqtpst.process_step_status_type_id = pst.id WHERE pswqtpst.process_step_work_queue_type_id = :processStepWorkQueueTypeId AND pswqtpst.archived is not true order by pst.process_step_status_type, cpst.process_step_status_type
